descriptionText:
Deloitte is hiring an Oracle HCM Cloud Core HR Analyst to support the design and delivery of Oracle HCM Cloud integrations and data conversion. The role also supports testing, implementation documentation, deployment, go-live, and post-production stabilization for client projects.
Responsibilities
Supporting the design and delivery of Oracle HCM Cloud integrations with connected enterprise systems
Assisting with inbound and outbound interface development, data mapping, middleware coordination, and integration documentation
Participating in integration testing, issue tracking, defect resolution, and end-to-end validation activities
Supporting data conversion activities, including data extraction, cleansing, transformation, loading, reconciliation, and cutover preparation
Collaborating with HR, security, reporting, and technical teams to understand dependencies and support project requirements
Maintaining project documentation, status updates, risks, action items, and technical deliverables throughout the implementation lifecycle
Supporting deployment, go-live, and post-production stabilization activities while following established Deloitte delivery methods and quality standards
Skills
Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
1+ years of experience delivering Oracle HCM Cloud technical solutions
Ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust clearance for this role
Bachelor's degree
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
Experience delivering across multiple Oracle HCM Cloud implementations within large-scale, multi-stakeholder public sector programs supporting 10,000+ employees
Experience in government and public sector implementations
Oracle HCM Cloud certified
Company Overview
Deloitte is a business consulting company that offers audit, consulting, financial advisory, and tax services. It was founded in 1845, and is headquartered in London, England, GBR, with a workforce of 10001+ employees. Its website is https://www2.deloitte.com.
